pages.text: When a machine stops, check in order: FE and energy storage; bee, comb and flower recipe match; redstone control; side configuration; and free space in item slots and fluid tanks.

pages.title: Pipes or AE2
pages.text: Verify the ME network has power, a free channel, and storage space. For Mekanism pipes, set the connected face to the correct item or fluid input/output and enable automatic ejection when the machine should push. Check security permissions on shared servers.

pages.title: Restore a setting
pages.text: Stop normally, restore the group you changed, then reopen the world or restart the server. Capacity remains fixed during the current session.$(br2)A legacy-migration failure stops startup. Keep original files, backups and recovery files, repair the error, then start again. Do not delete the configuration or save incomplete files while running.

pages.title: Transfer result unknown
pages.text: Ordinary disconnection or full storage preserves contents already in the machine and known pending returns; reconnecting or freeing space allows them to continue. If a return, transfer or charge fails with an unknown actual result, the request is saved and that operation pauses. Keep the machine and logs; ask an operator to reconcile both endpoints before resolving it.

pages.title: Upgrade recovery paused
pages.text: Normal upgrades preserve complete fluids and paid progress. A partly failed apiary restoration retains its source and failure stage, then pauses production, active output and further upgrades. Include later pipe transfers of restored inventory when reconciling. Recovery records are evidence, not a second inventory; confirmation only resumes operation and does not reissue assets.

pages.title: Inspect the upgrade source
pages.text: In the machine's dimension, use /pbgoutput x y z status to inspect its request and /pbgoutput x y z upgrade-data requestUUID page to read the source. Only after reconciling the original machine, target, resource accounts and later transfers should an operator run /pbgoutput x y z confirm-upgrade-settled requestUUID to resume it.

pages.title: Repair an editor import
pages.text: Malformed fields retain their original values. Click the red value to open JSON, repair it, then check again. Unfinished numbers can be saved as drafts but must be valid before applying. Offline imports do not execute another pack's scripts; conditional or statically unresolved parts need author review.

pages.title: Application result missing
pages.text: Keep drafts and choose Check application result for the original operation. Reopening the editor or reconnecting to the original server in the same client process keeps pending queries available. A complete client restart does not restore that list automatically. Server records remain; keep drafts and the operation identifier.
